name: Canonical MicroK8s (Self-Hosted Kubernetes)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 single-package Kubernetes distribution for workstations, edge and clusters, with optional DNS, ingress and monitoring add-ons; no software license fee for self-managed use.
watch_out: Requires your own compatible Linux host(s), storage, networking and cluster operations; add-ons and external cloud resources may incur infrastructure costs. Commercial support and managed Kubernetes services are separate.
